Question: Aslamwlekum warhemtullah............. Dear Mufti sahab I Have 2 child i have put their name my son name is shoheb alam and doughter name is sahiba is that suitable name for muslims and would you say me meanings of these name ? i am wating for your repply. Answer ID: 11064 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 260/62=TL/1430) Shuaib Alam (or Suhaib Alam) is good name, but instead of Sahiba you can keep her name as Tahirah, Saimah, Khudaijah, Maryam, Fatimah etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
